posts.headline: Wall Street just had its worst week in more than a year — the Nasdaq wiped out its entire 2026 gain in the same week as the largest IPO in history.
posts.source: Source: CNBC & CNN market close, Nov. 20, 2026
posts.caption:
Wall Street just closed its worst week in more than a year — and if you own an index fund, a 401(k) or an RRSP, this one lands on you.

The Nasdaq fell about 5% Friday and is now negative for all of 2026, erasing a year of gains in a single week. The S&P 500 and Dow are both in a 'correction,' more than 10% below their records; the S&P finished at 6,910 (CNBC, CNN, Nov. 20).

Here's the part that surprised me: this was the same week Anthropic, the maker of Claude, pulled off the biggest IPO in history — about $81.3 billion raised at a $1.5 trillion valuation (AP, Yahoo Finance). A record-shattering debut, and it still couldn't steady the AI trade. Nvidia, a top holding in most index funds, fell about 13% Friday.

My take: a week this ugly is unnerving, but a retirement account is scored on the day you retire — not the day the headlines are worst.

Did this week push you to check your 401(k) or RRSP?
